description: Collections stored as `{ ids: [], entities: { [id]: item } }` for O(1) lookups and single-place updates.
Generates normalized initial state, CRUD reducer helpers (`setAll`, `updateOne`...) and memoized selectors.
Creates a thunk that dispatches `pending`, `fulfilled` and `rejected` around an async payload creator.
`createAsyncThunk` option that can cancel the thunk before it starts, e.g. to avoid duplicate requests.
`createListenerMiddleware()` runs async effects after matching actions, with `getState`, `dispatch`, `delay`, `cancelActiveListeners` and more.
Apply the change immediately, confirm with the server in the background and roll back with a visible message on failure.
